outcome: Requirement for continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
Successful treatment with HFNC within the first 3 hours of life
cohort: The study included 65 preterm infants born at 28 + 0 to 31 + 6 weeks' gestation.
finding: The primary use of HFNC successfully stabilized 86% of very preterm infants after birth, indicating it is an appropriate alternative to CPAP for immediate post-birth stabilization and transfer to the NICU.
cross-section timing: Stabilization observations were taken immediately after birth and within the first 3 hours of life.
